values.her2Dish: Positive (amplified, Group 1 result in greater than 10% of cell population)

report:
Breast, left, 2 o'clock, core biopsy, for HER-2 DISH test.

- HER2 DISH : Positive (amplified, Group 1 result in greater than 10% of cell population)
  - Number of tumour cell counted : 20
  - Average number of HER2 signals (black) per cell : 8.75
  - Average number of CEP17 signals (red) per cell : 2.05
  - HER2/CEP17 ratio : 4.27
  - Percentage of Cells with Amplified HER2 Signals : 90

Breast, left, 2 o'clock, core biopsy, for HER-2 DISH test - POSITIVE for HER2 amplification

- Cold ischaemia time : 20 min
  - Optimal (<= 60 min).
- Fixation time in buffered formalin : 18 hours
  - Optimal fixation (6-72 hours).
- Meet requirements specified in the latest version of the ASCO/CAP guidelines.

HER2 Dual ISH was performed on formalin-fixed paraffin embedded section with the Ventana INFORM HER2 Dual ISH DNA Probe Cocktail Assay on an automated system, and was examined by a pathologist under light microscopy.

Patients with breast cancers that are HER2 IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH amplified may be eligible for several therapies that disrupt HER2 signalling pathways.
